messages:
Ana Rivera: Quick orbital checklist  CloudScale wants the marketplace tile + Redwood landing + joint post to publish simultaneously. Ops window suggestions?
Mike Chen: Ops prefers 08:00-10:00 UTC to cover EU and early APAC. Shorter window reduces blast radius. @Priya does that work?
Priya (CloudScale): 08:00-10:00 UTC OK. We request embargo lift at 07:30 UTC so press partners can queue.
Julie Park: Design needs hero + one mobile + one desktop screenshot by EOD tomorrow. Mike, upload path?
Mike Chen: Assets will be uploaded to https://drive.redwood.co/marketplace/cloudscale/new-asset-batch by 18:00 PT.
Tom Reilly: Ops micro-run:
- 06:45 UTC: infra preflight (certs, DB replicas)
- 07:15 UTC: reduce DNS TTL + CDN warm
- 07:30 UTC: embargo lift & PR dispatch
- 08:00 UTC: publish landing + marketplace listing
- 08:05 UTC: smoke tests (signup, oauth, marketplace API)
Sree Nandakumar: SI EdgeWorks needs rotated API keys and a test tenant by 06:30 UTC. Tom, confirm provisioning ETA?
Tom Reilly: Confirmed provisioning complete by 06:00 UTC; will paste logs into the runbook.
Ana Rivera: Routing/URLs? Proposed /cloudscale-launch and /partners/cloudscale. Also ensure UTM template.
Mike Chen: Approved. I'll add UTM params and short redirects. Runbook link: https://handbook.redwood.co/launches/cloudscale-orbital-runbook
Julie Park: Partner quote due by 16:00 PT. Priya?
Priya (CloudScale): Quote coming by 16:00 PT. We'll be on standby 07:15-09:30 UTC.
Mike Chen: Launch coverage needed: 2 infra, 1 comms, 1 partner PM for 07:45-09:45 UTC. Volunteers?
Tom Reilly: I'll take infra primary 06:30-08:30 UTC.
Sree Nandakumar: I'll cover infra secondary 08:30-10:30 UTC.
Julie Park: I'll handle comms 07:15-09:15 UTC.
Ana Rivera: I'll post final go/no-go at 05:30 UTC day-of. If no objections we proceed. :rocket:
